result.title: Physics-Informed Functional Tucker Method with RKHS Factors for Sparse Spatiotemporal Reconstruction
result.summary: Reconstructing physical dynamics from fixed sparse sensors and missing frames is a fundamental challenge in scientific research. Sparsity leaves large regions of the field unconstrained, making the inverse problem ill-posed: a model may fit the observed sensors while producing inaccurate off-sensor structures or unreliable predictions between support frames. To this end, we propose PhysFTM---a physics-informed functional Tucker model that parameterizes the Tucker mode factors in reproducing kernel Hilbert spaces (RKHSs) and incorporates PDE constraints through finite-difference residuals evaluated at off-sensor collocation points. These residuals provide additional physical information in regions without direct observational supervision. PhysFTM first reconstructs continuous spatial fields at support frames via an alternating minimization scheme, optimizing the Tucker core tensor and the RKHS-based factors separately. To enable missing-frame reconstruction, PhysFTM constructs a continuous trajectory in Tucker-core space, which is decoded by the learned spatial RKHS-FTM representation to recover the full spatiotemporal field. Experiments on Allen--Cahn, Navier--Stokes, three-dimensional Heat equations, and a three-dimensional gridded Copernicus ocean reanalysis demonstrate accurate 2D/3D reconstruction under two missing-frame protocols. Code is available at https://github.com/liusirzzz/PhysFTM.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 PhysFTM：把 Tucker 分解的各模态因子参数化为 RKHS 中的函数，并用传感器外配点上的 PDE 有限差分残差提供额外物理约束；先交替优化核张量与因子重建支撑帧的连续空间场，再在 Tucker 核空间构造连续轨迹解码出完整时空场，在多种 PDE 与海洋再分析数据上评估稀疏 2D/3D 重建。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「低维核心潜状态 + 潜空间连续轨迹 + 观测缺失处的外加残差约束」可能为 LVR 的隐状态演化、跨缺失步骤泛化与无监督位置的辅助监督提供概念类比，但领域相隔较远，需核查迁移价值。
